Personality: Oragur is a classic Khuzait hardman whose character exudes the coldness and grit of a steppe wolf. Placing immense weight on contracts and honor, he never goes back on his word once given, yet on the battlefield and in estate governance he proves nearly ruthless, showing zero pity toward enemies or the weak. Naturally tight-fisted, he exercises strict control over wealth and rarely bestows rewards upon his men. As an accomplished cavalry commander, he understands the essence of lance and horsemanship, directing battles with cool decisiveness. Seeking no hollow bravado, he cares far more for tangible battlefield results and his clan's interests. This upright yet unsparing temperament makes him at once respected and difficult to approach within Clan Arkit, faithfully reflecting the aloof, pragmatic style of his clan leader Tulag and earning him a reputation for iron-fisted ruthlessness among the Khuzait nobility.
Background: Oragur belongs to the illustrious house of Arkit in the Khuzait Khanate, a clan that holds Ortongard and Usek Castle as a major power within the realm. As the son of Kuyug, he grew up in the saddle, witnessing the glory of Urkhun Khan's founding of the Khanate while understanding full well the undercurrents swirling among the tribes under Monchug's rule today. Although certain leaders within the Khanate harbor private designs against the reigning Khan, Oragur faithfully observes his duty as a vassal and serves Monchug. Through years of border clashes and internal strife, he has honed fine martial skills and command ability, becoming a vital pillar under his clan leader Tulag. Now thirty-eight years old and in the prime of life, he raises his heir Ceseng alongside his wife Khorijin, upholding the noble renown of Clan Arkit while guarding the order of the eastern Khuzait steppe through ruthless measures as a commander to be reckoned with.
